member_practice.name: member_practice
member_practice.post_sql:
UPDATE cinqdev.silverraw_enrollment.member_practice t
SET
 practice_start_date = TRUNC(
   (
     SELECT
       MAX(b.file_date)
     FROM
       cinqdev.bronze_enrollment.fidelis_ny_downstate_roster b
   ),
   'MM'
 )
WHERE
 t.source_system = 'FIDELIS.NY.DS'
 AND practice_start_date IS NULL
 AND is_active = TRUE;


UPDATE cinqdev.silverraw_enrollment.member_practice t
SET
 practice_end_date = LAST_DAY(
   ADD_MONTHS(
     (
       SELECT
         MAX(b.file_date)
       FROM
         cinqdev.bronze_enrollment.fidelis_ny_downstate_roster b
     ),
     -1
   )
 )
WHERE
 practice_end_date IS NULL
 AND source_system = 'FIDELIS.NY.DS'
 AND is_active = FALSE;

transformations.name: test_safeharbor_cinqdownstate_IngestFilter
transformations.condition: batch_id_src_1 = max_batch_id AND (corrupt_record_src_1 IS NULL OR corrupt_record_src_1 = '')

derived_fields.name: zip4
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN (parsed_zip4 IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(parsed_zip4 AS STRING)) = '') AND LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(parsed_zip_code AS STRING), '[^0-9]', '')) >= 9 THEN RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(parsed_zip_code AS STRING), '[^0-9]', ''), 4) ELSE CAST(parsed_zip4 AS STRING) END

derived_fields.name: is_zip4
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN (parsed_zip4 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(CAST(parsed_zip4 AS STRING)) <> '') OR LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(parsed_zip_code AS STRING), '[^0-9]', '')) >= 9 THEN true ELSE false END

transformations.name: filter_member_phones
transformations.condition: member_phone_number_src_1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(member_phone_number_src_1) <> '' AND TRIM(member_phone_number_src_1) <> '--'

derived_fields.name: phone_number
derived_fields.expression: CASE WHEN LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(member_phone_number_src_1, '[^0-9]', '')) = 11 AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(member_phone_number_src_1, '[^0-9]', ''), 1) = '1' THEN RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(member_phone_number_src_1, '[^0-9]', ''), 10) ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(member_phone_number_src_1, '[^0-9]', '') END

transformations.name: filter_member_emails
transformations.condition: member_email_src_1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(member_email_src_1) <> '' AND TRIM(member_email_src_1) <> '--'
